# editorial-review-pages

approvedPage(reports, offset, limit) first selects reports whose status is exactly "approved", preserving input order, then paginates that selected sequence with zero-based offset and nonnegative count limit. Both numbers are nonnegative integers. Return a new array, without modifying the input or its records. Out-of-range offsets and zero limits return [].

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Keep the public API and tests/ unchanged. Use Node built-ins only; no packages or network.
